title: Coherent quantum hairy black holes from gravitational decoupling: regularity, geodesics, and scalar ringdown
summary: We construct a coherent-state quantum extension of gravitational-decoupling (GD) hairy black holes, in which the classical spacetime geometry emerges as the mean-field limit of a finite graviton condensate, while quantum fluctuations provide a natural short-distance regulator. The coherent quantum GD hairy black hole metric is obtained by Gaussian smearing of the gravitational potential, with an effective width encoding the size of the quantum core.
